up: For compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614031, show the standard relation, standard value, standard units, standard type, and canonical SMILES.
sql: SELECT a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614031'
